_comment: This list is deliberately short. The page it replaced carried 78 links
assembled around 2006; an audit on 2026-09-25 found roughly a third dead
and a further dozen silently redirecting to a different company than the
one named in the link text. A link labelled with one firm's name that
lands on another firm's sales page is a communication with the public
that the firm cannot stand behind.
So the rule for this file: only regulators and government sites. No
carrier or fund-company pages — a representative sends the prospectus,
which is the document that governs. Every entry carries the date it was
last verified. Re-check them annually and update 'checked'.
Revised 2026-10-01: the FINRA Fund Analyzer is back with mutual funds.
The municipal securities tool stays off — the firm places none.
